question: P4 run-04 (decisions of entry 25 applied): 115/164 scenarios pass. How should the remaining collapse failures at crease regions (D) and the five foot-reach failures (G) be handled?

facts.note: Most foot_lock cases are settle steps or held feet moving the hip through groin triangles that the Walk clip itself already folds (area large, normal reversed: the clip check gates area only and reports flips). folded_in_clip: a source clip has the triangle folded or under 5 %. blend: both clips open, the blend compresses it.
facts.feet_reach_limit: Run->Walk at 1.5x (100 and 400 ms, both feet variants) and the Walk<->Run repeated switch: running at 5.25 m/s the body passes the locked foot faster than the leg can reach; the foot is dragged 15-53 mm
facts.budget: active time at pause-25 recorded in runs/qa/ro-swordsman-character-v1/v001/v001-pause-25.json

options.D1: fix the crease regions in the foundation (b21: skin weights or correctives at the groin, the back of the knee and the armpits), add a fold gate to the clip check, re-verify all seven clips and P4; estimated 3-5 h, which would use most of the remaining trial budget before the combo clip and P5
options.D2: keep the collapse gate strict: close P4 with these scenarios listed as known failures and the crease sites recorded for the next foundation revision, then decide the combo clip and P5
options.D3: judge transition collapse only on triangles open and above 5 % in every active source clip (gate-scope change); the foot_lock and blend cases would still fail

decisions.topic: foot reach limit at the fastest settings

options.G1: keep the feet gate strict and list the five scenarios as known failures (the physical limit of in-place cross-fades at 1.5x running)
options.G2: add a re-plant step when the leg runs out of reach (about 1 h; more leg motion through the crease regions)
options.G3: take Run->Walk at 1.5x with these blends out of the transition table (scope change)

resolution.user_text: D2; 允許將時間擴充至 36小時 / G1 列為已知失敗 (Recommended)
